claim: The claim that COVID-19 vaccines contain graphene oxide (a two-dimensional carbon nanomaterial) as an undeclared additive traces to two 2021 reports by Dr. Pablo Campra (University of Almería, Spain), both self-published and neither peer-reviewed. The first (June 2021) examined a single Pfizer Comirnaty vial of untraced origin by optical and electron microscopy alone. The second (November 2, 2021) did run micro-Raman spectroscopy, the technique that can identify graphene, on seven vials, and reported graphene oxide as 'conclusive' in 8 of about 110 screened objects. That report does not settle the question on its own terms: the Raman bands it relies on (a 'G' band near 1585 cm⁻¹ and a 'D' band near 1344 cm⁻¹) are common to essentially any disordered or amorphous carbon and are not specific to graphene, and Campra's own text says confirmation would need further techniques (XPS spectroscopy, TEM electron diffraction) he did not perform, on a vial whose origin he did not establish. The University of Almería stated it ran no such study and that the report is one professor's unofficial analysis of a sample with no traceability. Independent reviewers assembled by Science Feedback (2021) and multiple fact-checks found no evidence of graphene in the vaccine, and the ingredient lists published by the U.S. FDA and the European Medicines Agency (EMA) contain no graphene oxide.

notes: Group B (disputed/debunked) from capture DabC5nzSptx. Documents the graphene-oxide-in-vaccines claim and its named rebuttal per the 'reader chooses' ethos — the claim exists and is traceable (Campra's reports), and the rebuttal is specific and on the record. CORRECTION 2026-07-13: the earlier claim text said Campra 'did not use Raman spectroscopy … a report that ran none.' That was true of his first report (June 2021, microscopy only) but FALSE as written — Campra published a second 75-page report dated Nov 2, 2021 ('Detection of Graphene in COVID19 Vaccines by Micro-Raman Spectroscopy', ResearchGate 355979001) whose entire method is micro-Raman and which claims GO 'conclusive in 8 of ~110 objects'. Claim rewritten to describe both reports accurately and to move the rebuttal onto solid ground: (a) both are self-published, non-peer-reviewed; (b) the G band (~1585 cm⁻¹) and D band (~1344 cm⁻¹) he cites are generic to any sp² / disordered / amorphous carbon (graphite, soot, char, CNT), not specific to graphene — definitive ID needs the 2D-band ratio + XPS/TEM, which Campra's own text concedes he did not run; (c) sample origin untraced; (d) University of Almería disavowed it (Verificat). What is verified here is the documentation of both sides, not the claim. Wider roster dug 2026-07-13 (Young/Acta Scientific+self-pub, Gatti&Montanari/MedCrave [metals, NOT graphene], Diblasi&Sangorrín/IJVTPR, Korea Veritas Doctors, Noack 'graphene hydroxide' video-only, Nixon/Mihalcea/Nagase self-pub): every graphene-detection artifact is in a non-indexed/predatory/fringe venue (chiefly IJVTPR — Crossref-registered but not PubMed/Scopus/WoS/DOAJ, in-house non-blind review) or self-published/video, and every identification is by morphology/optical comparison to a graphene standard, never an indexed spectroscopic confirmation; named institutions (Almería, CONICET, BDP, MHRA) distanced. The claim propagated via La Quinta Columna (Ricardo Delgado) and Astrid Stuckelberger. It was presented, not adopted, at the Luxembourg Chamber of Deputies petition-2489 hearing on 23 April 2025 (see capture note); the Chamber rejected the petition. NOT Group A: it documents a contested public claim, not an independently verified true fact. Pairs with [[2021-moderna-recall-001]], the real metallic (stainless-steel) contamination event the same reel misreads as graphene. The substantive peer-reviewed 'undeclared contaminant' story is not graphene but residual plasmid DNA + the undeclared SV40 promoter-enhancer (Speicher/McKernan, Autoimmunity 2025; Buckhaults SC Senate testimony 2023; Health Canada + FDA confirm the sequence is present) — candidate for its own record. Grep-first note: not an EFTA-corpus subject (vaccine/graphene, no Epstein nexus).
